package controller

import (
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

	operatorapi "BASELINE_MODULE/api/v1alpha1"
)

func integrationImplementation() integrationAdapter {
	return integrationAdapter{
		object: func() *unstructured.Unstructured {
			resource := &unstructured.Unstructured{}
			resource.SetGroupVersionKind(operatorapi.GroupVersion.WithKind("OPERATOR_KIND"))
			return resource
		},
		register: operatorapi.AddToScheme,
		reconciler: func(kube client.Client, scheme *runtime.Scheme) integrationController {
			return &OPERATOR_KINDReconciler{Client: kube, Scheme: scheme}
		},
	}
}
